description: This Go source file defines a wrapper around the sqlx database library, providing enhanced functionality such as timeout handling, tracing, and online status monitoring for database operations within the Mattermost server project.

classes.name: sqlxDBWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper around sqlx.DB adding timeout, tracing, and online status features.

classes.name: sqlxTxWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper around sqlx.Tx providing timeout, tracing, and online status features for transactions.
